stances_toward.note: Gagauzia is an autonomous territorial unit inside Moldova and under Chișinău's control: controlled and claimed. The relation is cooling: governor Evghenia Gutsul sentenced to seven years (5 Aug 2025) for passing Russian money to the banned Shor party, the Constitutional Court ruling of 9 Jul 2026 curtailing Gagauz powers, the People's Assembly declaring the Bashkan post vacant on 17 Aug 2026, an election on 15 Nov 2026 under a Romanian-language requirement the opposition contests. Gutsul's own line, reported by BESA, is that Gagauzia would start secession if Moldova unites with Romania. Bond - grievance: autonomy won in 1994 after the 1990 secession attempt, now contested.

relations_to.summary: The Chișinău court convicted Gagauzia's governor Evghenia Gutsul on 5 Aug 2025 and sentenced her to seven years (prosecutors had asked nine) for channelling Russian money to the banned Shor party in 2019-22 and receiving MDL 42.5m (about USD 2.5m) from an organised criminal group; she denies the charges and calls them political.
